description:
The Office of Human Resources (OHR) IT unit is responsible for supporting OHR’s mission of collaborating with client departments to deliver quality customer service. This position will be a member of a small team that supports existing and evolving applications using HTML, ASP, XML, SQL, MS Access, Excel, and various Reporting tools. Applications are both web applications and client server deployed. Support for off-the-shelf software is also required, as well as the development of new applications.
 Essential Functions 
 Participate as a team member to support and facilitate the use of applications in the department which includes understanding Human Resources operations
 Work closely with the project team members to develop quality documentation and test plans
 Develop or maintain efficient HR Websites, queries, scripts, macros, views and other methods requests
 Demonstrated ability to learn new software and/or technologies and determine appropriate uses based on user requirements 
 Develop and optimize complex HR reporting needs using Web based methodologies, existing EiS and/or OBIEE reporting tools, and/or MS/Oracle SQL reporting tools in multiple database environments
 Work well with Office of Human Resources (OHR), Office of Innovation and Technology (OIT) resources and other departments on inter-departmental tasks and projects
 Gather user requirements and develop applications, Web based, and otherwise
 Help coordinate the implementation of short- and long-term projects, objectives, policies and procedures for the production and maintenance of all application development related issues
 Follow SDLC methodology including requirements gathering, solution architecture, coding, and testing
 Review code and high-level designs by other team members to ensure that strategic objectives and business needs are met
 Proactively identify application inefficiencies and propose solutions
 Identify, create, and maintain development frameworks and code libraries
 Create prototypes and functional specifications for application development projects
 Work closely with the team members and QA analysts to develop quality assurance documentation and test plans
 Work closely with production support and help desk staff to develop operating documentation.
 Make suggestions on creating technical standards for specific applications and the City as a whole
 Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities 
 Apply application development standards and best practices
 Understand application and network architecture
 Reliably deliver work of the highest standards on time
 Solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
 Interpret a variety of instructions, furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form and communicate them effectively
 Include documentation both external to, and internal to, applications
 Document code or processes written by other programmers or vendors
 Diagnose and communicate software & hardware issues, suggest fixes, as appropriate to vendors
 Upgrade or repurpose existing applications & equipment
 Demonstrate exemplary communication skills with management, administrative and technical staff
 Working Knowledge of: 
 HTML, ASP, XML, C-Sharp, JavaScript, PHP, CSS
 PeopleAdmin, Testing Software i.e. Sigma, Scantron
 Client Server architecture & Web architecture, including Web services
 SQL, stored procedures and efficient use of SQL query language, and scheduled jobs.
 Microsoft tools, VB, MS Access coding a plus
 Network Administration, Active Directory, Desktop Services, Hardware & Software configurations
 LAN / WAN support knowledge
 
 Required: 
 Completion of a Bachelor’s Degree program at an accredited college or university that includes major course work in computer sciences, management information systems or a related field
 2-3 years of experience with Human Resources Systems including configurations, customizations – Preferably with Web/SQL development and interfacing with HR systems
 2-3 years of programming experience with HTML, ASP JavaScript,, XML, MS Access, SQL, PL/SQL or similar products
 2-3 years of experience with HR based reporting tools or Data Warehouse knowledge such as EiS, Report Writer, Cognos, OBIEE, similar transaction based / data warehousing and reporting tools
 Working with a team in a knowledge sharing environment
 
 Salary Range: $80,000 - $87,000
 Starting salary to be determined based on experience and qualifications. 
 All applications should include the following: 

•    Cover Letter clarifying your interest and qualifications for the role.

•    Resume

 We won’t accept or review incomplete applications. 
 Work Setting: in-person (onsite)
 Discover the Perks of Being a City of Philadelphia Employee:

•    We offer Comprehensive health coverage for employees and their eligible dependents

•    Our wellness program offers eligibility into the discounted medical plan

•    Employees receive paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays

•    Pay off your student loans faster - As a qualifying employer, City of Philadelphia employees are eligible to participate in the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program. Join the ranks of hundreds of employees who have already benefited from this program and achieved student loan forgiveness.

•    Enjoy a Free Commute on SEPTA - Starting September 1, 2023, eligible City employees will no longer have to worry about paying for SEPTA public transportation. Whether you're a full-time, part-time, or provisional employee, you can seize the opportunity to sign up for the SEPTA Key Advantage Program and receive free Key cards for free rides on SEPTA buses, trains, trolleys, and regional rails.

•    Unlock Tuition Discounts and Scholarships - The City of Philadelphia has forged partnerships with over a dozen esteemed colleges and universities in the area, ensuring that our employees have access to a wide range of tuition discounts and scholarships. Join the City of Philadelphia team today and seize these incredible benefits designed to enhance your financial well-being and personal growth!
 *The successful candidate must be a city of Philadelphia resident within six months of hire
